_note: Draft IMD job. Field names follow the IMD worker's TaskDescriptor / LotusJobRequest schemas; map them onto the public paid-posting API when it opens. `guidance` = skills/prove/SKILL.md without its YAML front matter. <COMMIT> = the round's commit in this repository. <ID>, <TITLE>, <CLAIM> come from ledger/ledger.json.
objective: 🐸 Fren Review PROVE <ID> — be the hostile verifier for a reported vulnerability in the Magic Internet Frens Cauldron. The report: <TITLE>. <CLAIM> Follow the PROVE procedure in skills/prove/SKILL.md: restate the claim as the invariant it breaks, try to refute it first (guards, trust circle, reachability through public calls, deploy-time parameters), then reproduce it faithfully on test/fren-review/FrenBase.sol against the real contracts, writing only under test/fren-review/<ID>/, and push it to its true worst case. If it reproduces, the test asserts the harmful outcome in numbers and passes on today's code, next to a control; if it does not, the test asserts the defence holding against the exact claimed sequence and your message names the guard.
acceptanceCriteria: A test file exists under test/fren-review/<ID>/ that exercises the real contracts through FrenBase and asserts assertTrue(active).

The test meets the skills/prove/SKILL.md proof standard (outsider actors only, no vm.store / vm.etch on protocol contracts) and asserts a concrete effect: the harmful outcome plus a control if the claim reproduces (test_<ID>_Exploit..., test_<ID>_Control...), or the defence holding against the claimed sequence if it does not (test_<ID>_Refuted...).
forge build and forge test pass.

The final message starts with `FREN-REVIEW PROVE <ID>: reproduced` or `FREN-REVIEW PROVE <ID>: not-reproducible`, then a `severity: <assessed> (reported: <theirs>) because ...` line, then the evidence; a refutation names the guard at file:line.
No transaction is sent to any live network and no private key is used.
